summary.en: Conan begins by asking Amuro about the dish mentioned by a woman standing in line in the afternoon. He asks him why doing it at this particular moment, but gives him a proper answer regardless, and suggests he do so with Azusa. Conan asks her what is new on the menu directly, but she is unable to remember it due to the way her boss named it: Charcoal burner’s something. He then asks her again how she and Amuro were allowed to visit the museum, to which she responds immaculately. Conan also reminds himself not to forget Kazami, and asks about his schedule since he overheard Amuro's call with him. Kazami replies to him impatiently, which Amuro explains why Conan does not have to know. Amuro then asks Kazami personally about the scene, which he deemed there was nothing suspicious. Conan then asks to see photos of the exhibition hall, where he finds something strange in the middle leg of a bench. He continues with the white paint marks in the hands of Amuro, Kazami, and Azusa after accidentally seeing that of Amuro.
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。
